mechanism.claim: A large daily rise or fall in newspaper-based US Economic Policy Uncertainty during elevated BTC variation identifies an extreme uncertainty shock. Consistent with evidence that Bitcoin can hedge uncertainty at distribution tails, follow the EPU change direction for one day.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed source-day log EPU change
mechanism.why_distinct: No existing repository alpha uses the official daily US EPU index. FX, Treasury, Cboe, fear-greed, premium, options, and on-chain candidates use different economic objects and clocks.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: quantile-causality research reports EPU predictive content for Bitcoin returns especially under extreme market conditions, and the candidate additionally requires causal high BTC variation
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a conservatively delayed official news-uncertainty clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: official Baker-Bloom-Davis US Daily News-Based Economic Policy Uncertainty CSV
features.observation: positive finite daily_policy_index for calendar day D
features.availability: D+2 00:00 UTC, deliberately later than the next-day daily release; no same-day or D+1 use
features.valid_change: D and D-1 exact consecutive calendar observations, both positive
features.epu_shock_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(epu_change) over at most 270 valid changes, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over UTC day D+1, ending at decision)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: daily nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_epu_tail: EPU direction and high BTC variation without shock rank
definitions.no_btc_variation_gate: EPU shock tail without BTC variation rank
definitions.one_day_stale_epu: prior exact EPU change with current BTC variation gate

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.paper: When, where, and how economic policy uncertainty predicts Bitcoin returns and volatility? A quantiles-based analysis, Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance 80 (2021) 65-73
research_boundary.selection_basis: independent official daily news uncertainty mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, delay, rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
